name: Oleksandr Avramchuk
tagline: Historian of the Cold War, cultural diplomacy, and East-Central Europe.
intro: I study how scholars, diplomats, foundations, émigré intellectuals, and institutions created ways of thinking about Eastern Europe across the Cold War divide. My work focuses especially on the circulation of ideas between the United States, Poland, Ukraine, and émigré communities.
home_research_heading: Ideas, institutions, and the Cold War divide
home_research_intro: Four connected areas organize my current work.
